notes.title: ♻️🎮♻️ Update on Discounts for Our Game Bundles in Steam ♻️🎮♻️
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33025983/d65163e420dba5d9f066cdfb821f360e7f1d745a.png

Dear Players,

According to the new Steam rules, to avoid increasing the prices of our games (currently 2 USD without a discount), we are forced to reduce the discount on all our bundles to 10%. If the discount exceeds this threshold, the bundles will not be displayed in the Steam store and will not be available for purchase. This adjustment is necessary to ensure that our bundles remain accessible to you.

However, the discount on a bundle may vary depending on the number of discounts applied to the individual games within it. Therefore, stay tuned for our discount announcements so you don’t miss out on great deals!

Thank you for your support!

Best Regards

Blender Games


If you have one or several of our games, you can purchase our Bundle's with a higher discount!)
